name: autoresearch
tagline_zh: 丢个主题，它自己上网查证、写带引用的报告，还能顺手整理进你的笔记库。不像别的工具，它每次只跑有限轮，绝不漫无边际。
tagline_en: Drop a topic, it researches the web, drafts a cited dossier, and offers to merge into your vault—bounded loops.
desc_en: Run a bounded, source-grounded research loop, draft a cited dossier, and optionally propose a separately reviewed canonical vault merge. Use when the user wants autonomous or deep research that may access the public web. Triggers: /autoresearch, autoresearch, research this topic, deep dive into, investigate, find everything about, research and file, go research, build a wiki on.
why_zh: 同类工具要么无限爬取，要么只给摘要。它用有限循环控制深度，且合并前单独审阅，防止污染你的知识库。
why_en: Unlike endless crawlers or shallow summarizers, it bounds each loop and requires a separate review before vault merge—protecting.
